comments: Accessible is a diagnostic tool, not an overlay: it does not inject code or change pages. Monitor (real-user monitoring on one domain) is free with no card. Scanning, screen-reader journeys and reports are on paid plans: Starter $99 and Professional $299 per domain per month, with a 7-day trial on the first paid plan. A single public page can also be checked free at https://accessible.so/scan. The same page checks are available to AI assistants through a remote MCP server (https://accessible.so/docs/assistants). Accessible does not certify conformance with WCAG or any law.
features: Online accessibility testing for websites. Scans every page with axe-core against WCAG 2.2 A/AA/AAA, sends a simulated screen-reader user through tasks such as sign-up and checkout and reports the step where it broke, and ranks the barriers real visitors hit using real-user monitoring. Free monitoring tier; paid plans per domain.
title: Accessible
